summary: The optional second review session runs after the primary in record, feedback, on-pass and both-pass, with session/v4 and iteration/v3 records, a kept second verdict, run-log lines and the end-of-run dissent list.
verified: vloop task gate T5 exited 0 and printed ok; go test ./..., go vet, gofmt, go mod tidy -diff and the linux/windows builds pass.
notes: reviewSession is now reviewRun (shared guards, phase-parametrised) plus a thin wrapper; the second review is secondReviewStep. The primary verdict is copied to reports right after the primary review, then removed from .vloop/tmp/ before the second session. session/v4 is written only for second-review sessions and iteration/v3 only when a second review ran; every other record stays v3/v2 so existing readers and tests are unchanged. Existing tests changed: wantIterations accepts iteration/v3 for iterations with a second review; schema list/count tests (schema_test.go, cli/schema_test.go, b2_e2e_test.go, embed_test.go) list the two new schemas (T5 acceptance 6). metrics/v4 is T6's. Under go test ./..., unset VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256.
